name: Sea Urchin (Uni)
siboNotes: Pure protein source that's naturally FODMAP-free and well-tolerated for SIBO patients. Rich in omega-3s which may support gut health.
preparationTips: Consume fresh or briefly seared to preserve delicate texture and flavor
Pair with low-FODMAP seasonings like lemon juice, chives, or nori
Best enjoyed at room temperature or slightly chilled
Quality varies significantly - source from reputable fishmongers
nutritionalHighlights: High in omega-3 fatty acids EPA and DHA
Excellent source of vitamin B12 and zinc
Rich in protein with all essential amino acids
